title: Final Prices With a Special Discount in a Shop
summary: Given an array of item prices, calculate the final price for each item after applying a discount based on the next lower-priced item.
statement: Given an array of item prices, calculate the final price for each item after applying a discount based on the next lower-priced item. If no lower-priced item is found, no discount is applied.
constraints: For each price, subtract the first later price less than or equal to it.
Leave the price unchanged when no later discount qualifies.
hints: Keep indices whose first qualifying later price has not appeared.
Maintain their prices in increasing stack order by resolving while top price >= current.
Subtract the current price from every popped index.
An index is popped at its first qualifying later value, exactly matching the discount definition.
editorial: An index is popped at its first qualifying later value, exactly matching the discount definition.

tests.explanation: Discounts four, two, two, none, none produce 4,2,4,2,3.
No later value is less than or equal to an earlier one.
